name: Claude Code Plus
summary: 据发布者介绍，这款扩展在 Claude Code 面板旁显示计划，方便在切换话题或压缩上下文后继续跟踪未完成的任务。你可以按行号回复，并确认哪些提议应加入待办列表。

The publisher says the extension displays a plan beside Claude Code to help track open tasks across topic changes and context compaction. You can respond by row number and approve proposed tasks before they enter the to-do list.
